status: Generated by adapters/otel/trp_otel.py from receipts in vtr/vectors and conformance evidence in tests/evidence. tests/otel_check.py regenerates each file and compares it byte for byte, and tests/otel_sdk_check.py parses each one with the OTLP message classes of opentelemetry-proto 1.45.2.

opentelemetry_semantic_conventions.used_for: service.name and the attribute naming rules. Its gen_ai pages say those conventions moved to their own repository

opentelemetry_genai_semantic_conventions.used_for: gen_ai.agent.id, gen_ai.agent.version, gen_ai.provider.name and gen_ai.tool.name in model/gen-ai/registry.yaml, and the gen_ai.evaluation.result event in model/gen-ai/events.yaml, which the export does not use
opentelemetry_genai_semantic_conventions.note: The repository had no release tag when it was read, so the commit is the version.

opentelemetry_proto.used_for: the OTLP JSON encoding rules in docs/specification.md, the examples in examples/, LogRecord.event_name (field 12) and the Span and LogRecord fields

opentelemetry_specification.used_for: The rules for AnyValue and for attributes in specification/common/README.md
